description: This file defines the jQuery plugin 'EmailsComposeView' for handling email composition UI in SuiteCRM, including signature management, attachment handling, form validation, and interactions with TinyMCE editor.

methods.name: generateID
methods.description: Generates a UUID string used for attachment IDs.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the email form fields (to, cc, bcc, subject, body).

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form and shows error messages if invalid.

methods.name: isToValid
methods.description: Checks if the 'To' email addresses are valid.

methods.name: isCcValid
methods.description: Checks if the 'CC' email addresses are valid.

methods.name: isBccValid
methods.description: Checks if the 'BCC' email addresses are valid.

methods.name: isSubjectValid
methods.description: Checks if the email subject is not empty.

methods.name: isBodyValid
methods.description: Checks if the email body is not empty.

methods.name: setValidationMessage
methods.description: Sets the validation error message based on a label.

methods.name: isValidEmailAddresses
methods.description: Validates a list of email addresses.

methods.name: removeExistingSignatureClass
methods.description: Removes existing signature classes from the email content.

methods.name: updateSignature
methods.description: Updates the email signature based on selected signature ID.

methods.name: updateFromInfos
methods.description: Updates the display of 'From' field info.

methods.name: updateFromAddressName
methods.description: Updates the hidden 'from address' name based on selection.

methods.name: updateOutboundEmailId
methods.description: Updates the outbound email ID based on selected account.

methods.name: onFromSelect
methods.description: Handles change event when a 'From' account is selected.

methods.name: getFromEntryLabel
methods.description: Returns a formatted label for a 'From' account entry.

methods.name: tinyMceSetup
methods.description: Configures TinyMCE editor setup, including change and init events.

methods.name: onSendEmail
methods.description: Handles the email sending process, including form submission via AJAX.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Triggers email send after validation.

methods.name: attachFile
methods.description: Handles attaching files to the email.

methods.name: attachDocument
methods.description: Handles attaching documents via popup.

methods.name: updateDocumentIDs
methods.description: Updates document attachment input names.

methods.name: saveDraft
methods.description: Saves the email as draft via AJAX.

methods.name: onSavingDraft
methods.description: Performs the draft save operation.

methods.name: disregardDraft
methods.description: Disregards (deletes) the draft email.

methods.name: humanReadableFileSize
methods.description: Converts bytes to human-readable file size string.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes the email compose view, sets up event handlers, loads accounts, and TinyMCE.

methods.name: destruct
methods.description: Cleans up TinyMCE editors and UI elements.
